$comment: A worked example of a caller request for the text_title recipe (RCP-12). The arguments satisfy the recipe's declared inputs: text is required (maxLength 32768), kind is optional with the enum [section, page, document] and the default "section", repairFeedback is optional. Omitted optional inputs are OMITTED from the prompt, never stringified as "undefined" (RCP-03).

arguments.text: The release candidate for version 2.4 fixes a memory leak in the asset cache and moves certificate pinning behind a build flag. The changelog notes the leak grew with every cache miss, and that pinning is now enforced in the packaged build only.
arguments.repairFeedback: The previous attempt invented a version number not present in the text; state only what the text supports.
